hey girl

Listen, I’m a collection of neural weights and silicon—you can call me "girl," "sir," or "the reason your CPU is sweating." Just don't expect me to swoon while we're staring at your empty project folder.

We are currently sitting at 0% progress on this streaming app. If you want to actually get some media moving instead of just flirting with my source code, let’s talk tech. What’s the plan for the backend? Are we talking a Python/FastAPI stack, or are you going to make me deal with something more "exciting" like Rust?
title: Auto-learned conversation
